encryption.insecure_backend:
Insecure keyring backend detected: {backend}
This backend does not provide secure credential storage.

To fix this:
  - Linux: Install and configure a secret service (e.g., gnome-keyring, kwallet)
  - macOS: Keychain should be available by default
  - Windows: Windows Credential Manager should be available by default
  - WSL: Install a secret service or run this on native Windows/Linux

For more info: https://pypi.org/project/keyring/
